stem.text: The $I$–$V$ characteristics of two electrical components P and Q are shown.

stem.alt: Graph of I/A against V/V on a grid, with two curves labelled P and Q; P is a straight line through the origin and Q is a curve.

A.text: For a current of $0.5\,\text{A}$, the power dissipated in Q is double that in P.

B.text: For a current of $1.9\,\text{A}$, the resistance of Q is approximately half that of P.

C.text: The resistance of Q increases as the current in it increases.

D.text: P is a fixed resistor and Q is a filament lamp.
